mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which signals economic strength and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative when UNRATE is below 5%, or the mechanism's IC is below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% indicates tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, or the mechanism's IC is below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is low and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is high, it signals a tightening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive when UNRATE is low and FEDFUNDS are high, or the mechanism's IC is below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic demand, which should lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative when GDPC1 is high, or the mechanism's IC is below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply activity, which should lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative when INDPRO is rising, or the mechanism's IC is below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) is increasing and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is high, it signals a strong labor market but potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive when PAYEMS is increasing and FEDFUNDS are high, or the mechanism's IC is below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong demand, which should lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative when RSAFS is rising, or the mechanism's IC is below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 indicates weak demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive when HOUST is below 1200, or the mechanism's IC is below 0.03 in out-of-sample testing.
